name: com.sytecheck/sytecheck-mcp
title: SyteCheck
description: Scan a website for SEO, accessibility, performance and security issues, and read the report.

environmentVariables.name: SYTECHECK_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: SyteCheck API key, created at Account -> API keys on sytecheck.app. Begins with wak_.

environmentVariables.name: SYTECHECK_API_URL
environmentVariables.description: API base URL. Only set this to point at a non-production SyteCheck instance.
